text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun is doing some mental practice right before her race…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So if someone gets in my way, I'll slam on the breaks and…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you scared me! I had no idea you were here! What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess so. My heart just won't stop pounding.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: But… you'll be the one in a whole other world soon, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You'll totally be entranced by my running! ♪
